courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 相位式計算全像
related.transfer: 可遷移「離軸全像記錄與載波頻率」與「高度校正、波長與折射率追溯」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；相位式計算全像的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Off-axis hologram recording and carrier frequency" and "Height calibration, wavelength and refractive-index traceability" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Phase-only computer-generated holography must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦離軸全像記錄、數值重建與定量相位量測的誤差預算；相位式計算全像則以傅立葉全像的取樣、Gerchberg–Saxton 迭代、相位量化、相機閉環校正與全像顯示的工程化為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on off-axis hologram recording, numerical reconstruction and the error budget of quantitative phase measurement; Phase-only computer-generated holography centres on sampling of Fourier holograms, Gerchberg–Saxton iteration, phase quantization, camera-in-the-loop calibration and engineering of holographic displays, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「離軸干涉條紋與感測器」與「SLM 平面與傅立葉重建面」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到相位式計算全像，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「散斑、零階與波長的誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Off-axis fringes and the sensor” and “SLM plane and Fourier replay plane”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Phase-only computer-generated holography, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Speckle, zeroth-order and wavelength error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 白光干涉表面輪廓儀
related.transfer: 可遷移「離軸全像記錄與載波頻率」與「高度校正、波長與折射率追溯」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；白光干涉表面輪廓儀的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Off-axis hologram recording and carrier frequency" and "Height calibration, wavelength and refractive-index traceability" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of White-light interferometric profilometers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦離軸全像記錄、數值重建與定量相位量測的誤差預算；白光干涉表面輪廓儀則以低相干包絡定位、Mirau 干涉物鏡、垂直掃描與 ISO 25178 計量特性校正為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on off-axis hologram recording, numerical reconstruction and the error budget of quantitative phase measurement; White-light interferometric profilometers centres on low-coherence envelope localisation, Mirau interference objectives, vertical scanning and ISO 25178 metrological-characteristic calibration, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「離軸干涉條紋與感測器」與「寬頻光源與零光程差包絡」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到白光干涉表面輪廓儀，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「蝙蝠翼、異材相位與薄膜干擾」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Off-axis fringes and the sensor” and “Broadband source and zero-OPD envelope”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to White-light interferometric profilometers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Batwing artefacts, dissimilar-material phase and thin-film interference", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 數位全像顯微鏡
history.text: Gabor 在 1948 年提出全像術，Leith 與 Upatnieks 於 1962 年引入離軸參考光使影像項分離；Goodman 與 Lawrence 在 1967 年示範以電子感測器記錄全像並用電腦重建。1999 年 Cuche、Marquet 與 Depeursinge 在洛桑聯邦理工學院把離軸數位全像與顯微物鏡結合，從單張全像圖同時得到振幅與定量相位，隨後衍生出商用數位全像顯微鏡與活細胞定量相位成像；2010 年代起全像斷層技術進一步把多角度相位資料重建成三維折射率分佈。本課只重建公開的原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Gabor proposed holography in 1948; Leith and Upatnieks introduced the off-axis reference in 1962 to separate the image terms; Goodman and Lawrence in 1967 recorded holograms on an electronic sensor and reconstructed them by computer. In 1999 Cuche, Marquet and Depeursinge at EPFL combined off-axis digital holography with a microscope objective to obtain amplitude and quantitative phase from a single hologram, leading to commercial digital holographic microscopes and live-cell quantitative phase imaging; from the 2010s holotomography reconstructed multi-angle phase data into three-dimensional refractive-index maps. This course rebuilds only public principles and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「離軸全像記錄與載波頻率」到「系統驗證、比對與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Off-axis hologram recording and carrier frequency" through "System validation, comparison and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
